name: Google Calendar
description: A month calendar and daily agenda in the notch, read from Google Calendar iCal feeds.

settings.title: Week Starts On
settings.description: First column of the month grid and the week strip

settings.title: Time Format
settings.description: How event times are written in the agenda

settings.title: Highlight Days With Events
settings.description: Show days that have events in blue

settings.title: Show All-Day Events
settings.description: Include all-day events in the day's agenda

settings.title: Keep a Notch Chip
settings.description: Leave a calendar chip in the notch so you can open the lake any time. Off keeps the notch clear between events.

settings.title: Warn Before Events
settings.description: Peek the notch this many minutes before a timed event starts. 0 turns warnings off.

settings.title: Refresh Interval
settings.description: How often to download your calendar feeds again

settings.title: Calendar Address
settings.description: Right-click the lake > Open feeds.txt, then paste a calendar's Secret address in iCal format (Google Calendar > Settings > scroll to the bottom).
